name: aquaplants
description: AquaPlants / AquaBrain — plataforma de monitoreo de cultivos hidropónicos y aeropónicos

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/simulador && npm run build -w packages/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/backend && npm run typecheck -w packages/simulador && npm run typecheck -w packages/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w packages/shared && npm test -w packages/backend && npm test -w packages/simulador && npm test -w packages/frontend
